import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_histogram structure
class GSLHistogram(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('n', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('range', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ('bin', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    ]

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_histogram_increment(gsl_histogram * h, double x)
gsl.gsl_histogram_increment.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLHistogram), ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_histogram_increment.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Function to call the C function
def increment_histogram(histogram, x):
    return gsl.gsl_histogram_increment(ctypes.byref(histogram), x)

# Test cases

def assert_test():
    # Create a histogram with 10 bins
    n_bins = 10
    range_array = np.linspace(0.0, 10.0, n_bins + 1)
    bin_array = np.zeros(n_bins)

    # Convert numpy arrays to ctypes
    range_ctypes = (ctypes.c_double * len(range_array))(*range_array)
    bin_ctypes = (ctypes.c_double * len(bin_array))(*bin_array)

    # Create a GSLHistogram instance
    histogram = GSLHistogram(n=n_bins, range=range_ctypes, bin=bin_ctypes)

    # Test incrementing a value within range
    status = increment_histogram(histogram, 5.0)
    assert status == 0, "Expected GSL_SUCCESS"
    assert histogram.bin[5] == 1.0, "Bin value should be incremented"

    # Test incrementing a value outside range
    status = increment_histogram(histogram, 15.0)
    assert status != 0, "Expected error status for out of range"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
